thehush.configuration.title: The Hush
thehush.configuration.llm.anthropic.apiK: Your Anthropic API key (sk-ant-...). Saved to config/thehush-common.toml. Leave empty to use the environment variable instead.
thehush.configuration.llm.anthropic.mode: Claude model id, e.g. claude-sonnet-5 (quick, cheap) or claude-opus-5 (deeper).
thehush.configuration.llm.anthropic.effo: low, medium, high, xhigh or max. Low keeps replies quick.
thehush.configuration.llm.anthropic.inpu: Input price (USD per million tokens, 0 = built-in)
thehush.configuration.llm.anthropic.outp: Output price (USD per million tokens, 0 = built-in)
thehush.configuration.returnDelaySeconds: Seconds before he returns from death
thehush.configuration.guideMinutes: Minutes of silence before he guides
thehush.configuration.autoArrival: Opening storm brings him to a fresh world
thehush.configuration.unsaid: The Unsaid rise in soul sand valleys
thehush.configuration.voice.elevenlabs.a: Your ElevenLabs API key. Saved to config/thehush-common.toml. Leave empty to use the environment variable instead. The key needs Text to Speech access; give it User access too for the credit report.
Read the ElevenLabs key from this environment variable when the field above is empty.
thehush.configuration.voice.elevenlabs.m: eleven_v3_conversational: expressive, fast, reads [cues]. eleven_v3: most expressive, slower. eleven_multilingual_v2: lifelike, no cues. eleven_flash_v2_5: fastest, half the credits.
thehush.configuration.lineGapSeconds.too: Seconds of silence between one spoken line ending and the next beginning. Lines never overlap.
thehush.configuration.unseen.tooltip: Things heard and not seen, for players alone in the dark: footsteps behind you, a heartbeat under the sculk, a breath of silence, a knock, something below, the bell at night.
thehush.configuration.unseenMinutes.tool: About this long between them for a player alone in the dark; shorter as the road goes on.
thehush.configuration.llm.provider.toolt: Anthropic: Claude over the API (needs a key, costs money). Ollama: a model running locally (free, no key). OpenAI-compatible: any server speaking the OpenAI chat API, such as a LiteLLM gateway, OpenAI, OpenRouter, or LM Studio. Each has its own settings page below.
thehush.configuration.llm.ollama.url.too: Where Ollama is listening. The default is a local install.
thehush.configuration.llm.ollama.model.t: The model tag to use, already pulled (ollama pull <tag>). Pick one that supports tool calling, such as llama3.1 or qwen3, or he can talk but not act.
thehush.configuration.llm.ollama.think.t: Let a reasoning model think before it answers. Slower replies; leave off for chat.
thehush.configuration.llm.ollama.context: Tokens of context asked of the model. His prompt is about 10k before any conversation; 16k or more. Larger uses more memory.
thehush.configuration.voice.provider.too: None: text only. ElevenLabs: cloud voices (needs a key). OpenAI-compatible: any server speaking the OpenAI speech API, local (Kokoro, Orpheus, Chatterbox) or cloud (OpenAI, LiteLLM). Each has its own settings page below.
thehush.configuration.llm.anthropic.tool: Key, model, effort, and prices for Claude. Used when the provider is Anthropic.
thehush.configuration.llm.ollama.tooltip: Server, model, context window, and thinking for a local model. Used when the provider is Ollama.
thehush.configuration.llm.openai.tooltip: URL, key, model, and prices for a LiteLLM gateway, OpenAI, OpenRouter, LM Studio, vLLM, or Groq. Used when the provider is OpenAI-compatible.
thehush.configuration.llm.openai.url.too: LiteLLM's default is http://127.0.0.1:4000; OpenAI is https://api.openai.com/v1. With or without /v1.
Sent as a bearer token: a LiteLLM virtual key, an OpenAI key, or empty for a server that needs none.
thehush.configuration.llm.openai.model.t: As the server knows it: a LiteLLM alias, gpt-4o, and so on. Needs tool calling for him to act.
thehush.configuration.llm.openai.reasoni: low, medium or high for models that take reasoning_effort; empty sends nothing.
thehush.configuration.llm.openai.inputPr: Input price (USD per million tokens, 0 = unknown)
thehush.configuration.llm.openai.outputP: Output price (USD per million tokens, 0 = unknown)
thehush.configuration.debug.tooltip: The loopback bridge that lets outside tools read the live world. Off unless you are developing the mod.
thehush.configuration.bridge.tooltip: Serve the mod's state over HTTP on 127.0.0.1 for the developer tools in tools/mcp. Dev runs turn this on themselves.
thehush.configuration.bridgeToken.toolti: If set, requests to the bridge must carry it as a bearer token.
thehush.configuration.voice.elevenlabs.t: Key, voice, model, and style for ElevenLabs. Used when the voice provider is ElevenLabs.
thehush.configuration.voice.openai.toolt: URL, model, voice, and format for a Kokoro, Orpheus, or Chatterbox server, or for OpenAI. Used when the voice provider is OpenAI-compatible.
thehush.configuration.voice.openai.url.t: Kokoro-FastAPI listens on http://127.0.0.1:8880 by default; OpenAI is https://api.openai.com/v1.
thehush.configuration.voice.openai.apiKe: Bearer token, if the server wants one. Local servers usually do not.
thehush.configuration.voice.openai.model: kokoro, orpheus, chatterbox, tts-1, gpt-4o-mini-tts: whatever the server calls it.
thehush.configuration.voice.openai.voice: Kokoro: bm_george, bm_lewis, am_michael, af_heart. Orpheus: tara, leo, dan, zac. OpenAI: onyx, ash, echo.
thehush.configuration.voice.openai.forma: WAV works with every server. PCM is raw 16-bit audio at the sample rate below; smaller, but not every server offers it.
How his [bracketed] cues reach the engine. None: stripped (Kokoro, Chatterbox, tts-1). Instructions: an instructions field (OpenAI gpt-4o-mini-tts). Orpheus: inline emotion tags.
thehush.configuration.voice.openai.extra: Merged into every request for server-specific knobs, e.g. {"exaggeration": 0.6} for Chatterbox. Leave empty for none.
